mapper.select: SELECT * FROM app.contract WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM app.contract WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.contract(employee_id, contract_type, start_date, end_date, base_salary, payment_type, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{employeeId}, #{contractType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{baseSalary}, #{paymentType}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE app.contract SET contract_type = #{contractType}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, base_salary = #{baseSalary}, payment_type = #{paymentType}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND version = #{version}
